## Image Loader 0.7.1

This release refreshes Image Loader's public branding and simplifies the Gallery zoom display.

### Changed

- Removed the dark rectangle behind the Gallery Zoom HUD label.
- Kept Terraria's outlined text rendering so the zoom value remains readable over the world.
- Replaced the generic gradient README banner with reproducible Image Loader branding built from real in-game screenshots.
- Replaced the generic mod icon with a dedicated Image Loader pixel-canvas icon.
- Updated README screenshots with the current menu, Gallery view, Exact RGB placement, and map/minimap support.

### Compatibility

Built and compiled against Terraria 1.4.4.9 with the tModLoader 2026.08 preview line.
